title: SpaceX Crew Dragon Conducts Unique Flight Test dsg6WR4BWhw
description: A loud whoosh, faint smoke trail and billowing parachutes marked a successful demonstration Wednesday by SpaceX of its Crew Dragon spacecraft abort system – an important step in NASA’s endeavor to launch crews to the International Space Station from U.S. soil.
